text:
Nina: New partner wants listings in AWS/GCP/Azure. Asks: scripted IAM bootstrap, branding rules, SKU->billing mapping. Who takes what?
Tom: I can own AWS CFN + TF modules. Use role name rw-pub-<slug>-svc. Will add trust policy example.
Ravi: Ill do GCP service account + IAM bindings and sample gcloud commands. Also confirm AMI vs BYO image flow.
Nina: Partner prefers Redwood-published AMIs for AWS, BYO for GCP/Azure (BYO requires signed manifest).
Sasha (Legal): Legal intake required before publish. EU-only requests => DPA + SCCs. No unapproved comparative claims in marketing. Intake: https://redwood.internal/legal/publisher-intake
infra-bot: Onboarding checklist created: https://redwood.internal/onboard/4991234567 4dd Steps: create roles, upload branding, provide image manifest, submit legal intake, map SKUs.
Tom: Quick CFN snippet I'll include in repo: ```yaml
Resources:
  PublisherRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: rw-pub-${TenantSlug}-svc
```
Ravi: GCP sample: `gcloud iam service-accounts create rw-pub-<slug>` and `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding` examples. Will bind storage.objectViewer for images.
Nina: Branding constraints: PNG 240x80 or SVG, <=2MB, blurb <=300 chars. Portal should validate file type + length and show a preview.
Tom: Timeline: CFN + README by EOD today. Ravi: GCP templates by tomorrow. Sasha: legal review within ~48h after intake.
Nina: Perfect. If blockers pop up tag me here. We'll do a 15-min sync Friday if needed. :rocket:
